That is completely fine, Ashley. Getting to the mat or the weights when you're just not feeling it is a massive mental hurdle, and some days your body or mind just needs a break. 

We can handle this a couple of ways today. If you want to keep the momentum going without the heavy lifting, we could trim the session down — maybe just do a single set of each exercise to get some blood moving, or drop the accessories and just do a lighter version of the main lift. 

Alternatively, we can just write today off as a rest day and let you fully recover. 

How does your body actually feel right now? Are you just flat-out exhausted, or is it more of a mental block?

turns.reply:
I hear you, Ashley. When the weight of a rough few weeks piles up, trying to force yourself through a demanding training schedule is usually the first thing that breaks. It's not just about today; your overall recovery capacity is probably running on empty right now.

As your coach, my priority is keeping you moving in a way that supports your life rather than adding more stress to it. We should adjust the plan so it actually fits where your energy levels are right now. 

We can drop the volume on your training days to a lighter setting from this week forward, which will take the pressure off and let you focus on just showing up and doing what you can manage. 

Would you like me to make your sessions lighter for the rest of this block so we can give you some breathing room?
